title: Tens of thousands of alien satellites studying Earth before Sputnik

tellings.quote: that tens of thousands of alien satellites were studying our planet before we could even launch one of our own.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, presents the work of an astronomer named Beatriz Villarroel, who has looked at old photos of the night sky. He frames it as the possibility that tens of thousands of alien satellites were studying Earth before humans launched their first one, Sputnik, in 1957. If true, it would mean Earth was being watched from orbit before the space age began.
